overlay_rules: Patches replace fields on named nodes. add_nodes inserts new nodes. Tell windows not listed default to 1.

hidden_objection_layers_add.text: If you default, his son Rohit's engineering fee is at risk, and he can't bring himself to say he is choosing between you.

second_delayed_cost.text: Your cousin Rohit has stopped answering your messages.

k2.line: Haan, the form. See, first you help me with the shop GST return, it's due also. Then we sit with the form. After this week.

tells.reading: Third 'after this week'. A stall with no reason attached.
tells.false_positive: Real caution. Guarantor papers are serious.

tells.anchor: phrase:first you help me with the shop GST return
tells.reading: Surprise tactic: a counter-ask to delay the real ask.
tells.false_positive: He really does need help with GST. He's bad at it.

choices_add.text: Mama, you've said 'after this week' three times. What's actually worrying you?
I'll help with the GST. Sunday. And the form's separate, okay?

line_by_state.line: [He sits.] Minus since Diwali. And Rohit's fees, second year, BE, I have kept the FD for that. If I sign, and something happens, God forbid, then what do I tell him. Hemu, you fool. I couldn't say it. How do you say that to your sister's child.
[Long pause.] Statements. The current account is in minus. Since Diwali. Your Aai doesn't know.

choices_add.text: Then don't use Rohit's FD. The scheme also takes a co-guarantor at half liability. Baba could take the other half. You'd be at twenty thousand, not forty. I'd rather that than you choosing.

k6.line: Half. [He breathes out.] Your Baba will grumble. Let him grumble. Saturday. Good shirt.
